method: Lexical/source candidates plus manual objective inventory comparison. Four repeated draft concepts were rejected; the heuristic missed one of them, so it is not proof of semantic uniqueness.

records.reason: Nullable fallthrough tests whether null is supplied implicitly; 0330 tests a discarded match result. The expected repairs and the misconception about nullable contracts differ.
The new example tests an absolute read offset and subsequent cursor position; the pilot tests overwrite versus insertion at a write cursor. No content mutation occurs in 0416.
SQLite replacement cascades a deletion into dependent rows; 0358 examines invalid text coerced through an integer binding. Shared PDO setup does not supply the same answer.
Grouped fetching must retain duplicate first-column values; SELECT rowCount portability concerns result existence rather than representation or key collision.
Replacement deletes an already referenced row and cascades; deferred commit failure requires transaction cleanup. They exercise different statements, failure conditions and connection states.
Constructor-versus-clone hook invocation is distinct from readonly-property reinitialization needed to deep-clone a nested object.
The new clone changes copied scalar state and counts hooks; the earlier clone must repair a closure that remains bound to the original object.
Nullable return fallthrough concerns a function boundary; explicitly initialized nullable property storage concerns an object's initial state.
Missing function return and selecting a later named optional argument have different boundaries and no shared failing operation.
Month-end overflow occurs on an immutable date and skips an intended month; 0049 concerns mutating a retained DateTime alias through fluent calls.
Serialization policy determines whether a ghost initializes at all; non-lazy property writes concern which storage survives later initialization. Different triggers and guarantees.
A new exception thrown inside a catch bypasses sibling catches; 0014 chooses the first matching catch for the original try failure. Catch ordering alone cannot solve 0417.
The final 0459 exposes replacement parameter typing with SQLite typeof; 0358 distinguishes parameter coercion from validation of original text. The new input is already a valid integer.
Catch-region propagation differs from injecting an exception through delegated generators and resuming a recovered yield.
The throwing catch is already handling a prior exception; a throwing string conversion interrupts an echo expression without that handler-to-handler propagation.

0084 separates UTF-8 bytes from code points. The final 0487 assumes valid code-point slicing and exposes its inability to retain a multi-code-point grapheme cluster; the old repair mb_substr is precisely the new defective implementation.
Lazy initialization on serialization is separate from clone lifecycle hooks; neither example clones a lazy ghost or shares the same triggering operation.
Iterable admission tests arrays and Traversable versus Countable-only objects; scalar admission tests primitive PHP type categories. The interface boundary is essential only in 0471.
A Fiber's terminated state lacks a return after an exception; a failed static initializer can retry initialization later. Their persistent-state rules differ.
Fiber exceptional termination makes getReturn invalid; the generator task distinguishes yielded send values from a normal completed return. A normal completion is not the new case.
Numeric-string comparison uses numeric or lexical ordering, whereas slash division chooses an integer or float result type. Shared numeric vocabulary is incidental.
Clone hooks and constructor counts are unrelated to value/key callback argument order; the common arrays in output do not create a shared learning objective.

The pilot produces different values through a nonnull default and explicit null. 0405 deliberately has equal parameter values and requires func_num_args to recover call arity; default substitution alone cannot answer it.
Negative string-offset assignment has no boolean and/&& grouping; assignment tokens account for the superficial source resemblance.
Filtering requires correct callback parameter order and preserves selected keys; chunking partitions entries and separately chooses whether inner keys survive.
Fiber return availability after failure differs from reference-return alias binding; no reference container is involved in 0422.

0149 repairs encoding a space for a router. 0434 consumes literal plus and an encoded percent sequence under a one-decode contract. The inverse boundary and repeated-decoding trap require a distinct implementation decision.
String comparison classification has no precondition/postcondition loop choice; the lexical overlap is generic instructional wording.
Callback replacement text is not reinterpreted as a backreference template; numeric-string addition versus concatenation concerns an operator's arithmetic meaning.
Both inspect failure boundaries, but destructor lifetime after a factory returns differs from a driver deferring server validation to execute. Their triggering events and repair locations differ.
Boolean negation toggles one value; comparing two value objects by exact identifier text involves identity and numeric-string equality instead.

The new design must preserve a consumed nonseekable body through bounded replay before forwarding an immutable replacement. 0094 only propagates a request attribute and has no stream lifetime or size boundary.
Match-result orientation changes nested indexes; callback replacement strings bypass backreference expansion. The same regex family does not make these API representations interchangeable.
A for update clause executes after continue, while switch fallthrough advances through cases until break. Different control phases determine the trace.
continue 2 selects an outer loop; 0402 uses a single for loop and asks whether its update expression still executes.
WeakMap iteration retains a live object through a PHP variable; a foreign-key cascade removes database children. Retention versus deletion vocabulary crosses unrelated state models.
Toggling a boolean neither removes nor returns a queue entry; the common request to replace one expression is only format similarity.
Loop update output survives continue, whereas a thrown string conversion prevents completing an echo. The output ordering depends on unrelated control mechanisms.
PQ-061 uses match's strict identity between integer and string. 0403 compares two strings relationally, selecting numeric versus lexical rules; match strictness does not determine these results.
The earlier arrow refactor loses by-reference capture; the new regex callback returns literal dollar text. Capture semantics are not part of 0452.
Short-circuit evaluation controls which input reaches a throwing predicate; arrow capture controls whether outer state is mutated. Both callbacks are valid but differ for separate reasons.
PCRE array orientation and HTTP safe-versus-idempotent methods share only review phrasing, not code or a technical mechanism.
Fiber termination/getReturn is unrelated to evaluating match conditions and only the chosen result expression.
Negating a known boolean differs from parsing external boolean text while preserving an invalid sentinel. No input-validation interpretation is needed for 0466.

0392 schedules a Fiber check-then-mark single-use race; 0491 needs separate database sessions and stale read-compute-write transactions. Shared scheduling vocabulary is retained, but the transaction identity and anomaly differ.
A negative offset selects a byte from the end of a string; unary-minus/exponent precedence determines a numeric expression. The minus sign has unrelated roles.
Binary framing chooses integer width, byte order and payload byte count; HMAC output encoding chooses raw digest bytes rather than hexadecimal text before base64.
An iterable PHP value may be an array or Traversable; validating a JSON object's top-level shape distinguishes source document structures, not iteration interfaces.
For-loop update execution after continue differs from output during recursive descent and unwinding. There is no recursive call in 0402.
Relational comparison classifies two runtime strings; octal source-literal parsing occurs before arithmetic with a decimal string. The contexts have different conversion rules.
Writing one indexed byte has no lazy right-hand evaluation of ??=; the two assignment forms test different behavior.
Outer exception propagation is distinct from the explicit numeric level on continue; neither control instruction substitutes for the other.
Numeric-string arithmetic does not involve include/require failure severity; the comparison arises from generic refactor vocabulary.
Failed mapping preserves the old assignment target because the RHS never completes; regex callback text semantics can be observed with successful pure calls and no failure.
The for update phase runs after continue; a coalescing assignment evaluates its RHS only for missing/null storage. They have different triggering conditions.
Loop update sequencing does not depend on by-reference variadic unpacking; shared variables and increment syntax are incidental.
String relational comparison and array-key canonicalization apply different rules to numeric-looking strings. 0403 has no array-key insertion.
Negative string offsets operate on byte positions, whereas array_unshift renumbers numeric keys while retaining string keys. The indexed containers obey different rules.
A direct string-byte write does not exercise nested-array copy-on-write isolation; source assignment tokens are not enough to establish a duplicate.
0018 tracks two explicit owners until a destructor runs. 0425 reveals the hidden strong reference left in a WeakMap foreach key variable; removing the obvious owners is deliberately insufficient.
define returns a success flag distinct from its stored constant; recursive merge can turn colliding scalars into an array. Different return and representation contracts.
0201 groups a mixed addition-and-concatenation expression by PHP 8 precedence. 0449 uses only plus, so the error is choosing arithmetic for an identifier, not expression grouping.
Callback key assignment cannot rename source array keys; a regex callback's returned text is inserted literally. Neither fix addresses the other's contract.
Nested PCRE result dimensions have no missing-file include/require boundary; only generic review language overlaps.
Session class loading determines restored object type; repeated URL decoding invalidates a checked path representation. Their shared before/after wording is incidental.
NoRewindIterator preserves a cursor without advancing it; double URI decoding changes a path value after validation. No decoding occurs in the iterator task.
define's success result is documented normal behavior; missing keyed destructuring emits a diagnostic and assigns null. Both discuss assigned values but expose different APIs.
ASCII-only lowercasing and PDO integer coercion have different character and validation requirements; neither is a variation of the other's code.
Arithmetic overflow creates an out-of-range float before an int return fails; parameter binding can coerce external text. Range failure is not input-text validation.
Fixed byte-count chunks and splitting at the first delimiter use different partition rules; 0467 has no delimiter and retains a shorter final chunk.
A catch-thrown exception runs finally before an outer handler; recursion prints during stack unwinding without exceptions. The similar trace structure is incidental.
A terminated Fiber without a normal return differs from partial sscanf conversion results; no parser state or string fields occur in 0422.

0007 compares byte length and character count. 0475 must construct the longest valid prefix within a byte budget, rejecting both partial encodings and display-width choices; measuring length alone does not supply that cut.
The attribute quote delimiter determines an escaping test; JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION determines float wire spelling. Both exact-output tests target different encoding contracts.
Canonical normalization changes representations to composed form; grapheme extraction must preserve the original decomposed bytes. Their required operations cannot substitute for each other.
A byte-budget prefix may intentionally stop before a multi-byte character; the grapheme task chooses a user-visible cluster with no byte budget and must keep its combining code point.

0279 takes the shared transaction as a premise and tests whether a successful DO NOTHING statement inserted a claim. 0498 takes a correct atomic claim as a premise and tests crash windows created by separating commits. The faulty condition and faulty transaction boundary differ.

0240 requires a known fallback for an unknown backed value. 0494 expressly forbids assigning any known action and requires retaining the original unknown string in a separate representation; the earlier fallback would violate this contract.

Partial sscanf output contains an unassigned conversion slot. The localized-number validator must reject an unconsumed suffix even after successful numeric parsing and retain valid zero, using an explicit offset rather than conversion count.

0064 compares PHP DNF type declarations after flattening. 0443 implements a recursive ReflectionType admission predicate, requiring dispatch on intersection versus union nodes; it does not change the language declaration.
The earlier WeakMap value externally retains its own key. The new map loses its final key because foreach leaves a strong key variable alive; the retention path and required release action differ.

The pilot must leave a borrowed seekable handle advanced for the next line. The new middleware consumes a nonseekable body and must supply a bounded complete replay through an immutable replacement; preserving the original cursor is impossible and not the contract.

lengthReview.PHP-E26-0486: The apostrophe entity expands the exact expected test output. The options are input/output fixtures, not explanatory prose; adding words to the other fixtures would be artificial padding. Retain the meaningful encoding and flag it for independent review.

excludedDrafts.reason: Initial empty-execute assumption contradicted by runtime; replaced before acceptance.
Initial DST and LIKE tests duplicated 0254 and 0273.
Second substitution and delimiter tests duplicated 0210 and 0276.

limitations: This is author editorial review, not independent approval.
Lexical similarity misses some semantic repetition; manual objective review remains necessary.
Answer-length and position summaries are diagnostic signals, not proof that wording cannot leak an answer.
